dedupe_keys.name: shikoku electric power transmission and distribution grid access data configuration expected flows capacity outage plans and flow records

description: Shikoku Electric Power Transmission and Distribution, the grid operator for the Shikoku region, publishes a collection of grid access data for the bulk system of 187 kV and above and for local systems of 66 and 110 kV and below in Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima and Kochi prefectures. For each system the collection gives the grid configuration with expected flows and available capacity for transmission lines and transformers; planned work outages of transmission and substation equipment (annual plans for two years and at least one past year for the bulk system, fiscal 2025 to 2027, and one year plus past plans for local systems); and recorded demand at each point and grid flows for transmission lines and transformers, for fiscal 2025 with past years back to fiscal 2019 for the bulk system. Coverage is the Shikoku region. Files are free to download from the operator site; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page lists files without a description of their fields or caveats, so users should check each file before use. Simulation uses are regional transmission network models, connection and capacity studies, and outage scheduling analysis. Related records: data-chugoku-nw-grid-access-information covers the neighbouring Chugoku region.
